posts.name: MarioFanaticXV
posts.cooked:
Trying out new heroes is always my favorite part of an expansion (except Villains of the Multiverse, for obvious reasons). There's no particular hero I'm looking forward to the most, but with 11 new ones coming to us and a bunch of extra promos, I think it's safe to say that Oblivaeon will make me very happy in the end.

If I had to pick just one hero deck I'm most excited to play with, I think it'd be Luminary- mad scientists are always fun, and it's why Tachyon is one of my favorite heroes. Yes, I consider her a mad scientist, no, mad does not necessarily mean evil- my favorite example of any mad scientist is actually not a villain at all, but rather Doc Brown from Back to the Future.
